title: myseq
summary: seq(1) without options: LAST, FIRST LAST or FIRST INCREMENT LAST.
hints: `argc` tells you which of the three forms you got: 2, 3 or 4 means `LAST`, `FIRST LAST`, `FIRST INCREMENT LAST`.
Convert with `atoi`. With a positive increment loop while `i <= last`; with a negative one loop while `i >= last`.
